headline: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana leads today's tickets; Diwali tomorrow is expected to lift all three films, with wide ranges.
bullets: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana could reach 1.34M tickets today (range 1.12M to 1.60M), with the busiest hour ahead at 9–10 PM, around 96.1K (66.7K to 127K).
Its shows are 94% full or sold out, which drops the positive nudge from critics (+4%) and BookMyShow rating (+6%), so seats rather than interest limit upside.

Tomorrow, Sunday and Diwali could bring Namit Malhotra's Ramayana to about 1.41M tickets (1.05M to 1.78M), while Aadarsha Kutumbam is expected at 21.9K today (18.2K to 26.1K) and 23K tomorrow (17.1K to 29K).
Jailer 2 is expected at 28.5K today (23.8K to 34K), peaking at 2K around 9–10 PM (1.4K to 2.6K), and at 30K tomorrow (22.3K to 37.8K).
watch: Aadarsha Kutumbam and Jailer 2 have no review or word-of-mouth signals switched on, so their numbers rest on the usual day pattern alone.
Diwali tomorrow is an assumed x1.12 lift; if it proves weaker, tomorrow's figures could fall toward the low end of their ranges.
